thread:
incident-bot: PAGER — P1 SmartRouting quality regression detected. 5m spike in fallback to low-cost variant causing measurable quality degradation across multiple prod routes (text-gen, chat). Affected regions: us-west-2, eu-west-1. Observed: QA_accuracy baseline 0.92 -> 0.75; error rate 0.3% -> 2.1%; customer complaints increasing. Suspected: cost_preference routing policy routing traffic to redwood-7b-lite-4q (quantized) :rotating_light: https://console.redwood.company/incidents/1976543210

oncall-sre: I'm oncall. Taking ownership. Joining Zoom in 2m — will triage and coordinate. @raj @alex please post any immediate mitigations you can do. :raised_hand:

raj (runtime): Looking at routing controlplane. I can see a policy rollout at 2025-11-03T17:28:12Z (deploy id deploy-8792). It changed the policy 'prod-cost-priority' to prefer_variant=redwood-7b-lite-4q when cost_delta > 0.05. Traffic shift snapshot:
```
# snapshot from routing logs
route: chat-prod-us-west-2  | before: redwood-13b-standard=92%  | after: redwood-7b-lite-4q=58%  | timestamp: 2025-11-03T17:29:03Z
route: text-prod-eu-west-1  | redwood-13b-standard=88% -> redwood-7b-lite-4q=61%
```
I can also query control plane:
```
curl -sS https://controlplane.redwood/api/v1/policies/prod-cost-priority | jq '.rules'
# shows rule priority: [cost_prefer, latency, fallback]
```

mia (sre): Support reports: 4 app tickets in last 10m, 2 marked as high priority. CS says outputs are hallucinating / truncating for long prompts. Suggest immediate mitigation: disable prefer_cheap rule or block the cheap variant.

alex (eng-runtime): I'm on it. Performing emergency rollback of the policy to remove prefer_variant. Running rictl now.
```
# dry-run first
rictl policy update --id prod-cost-priority --remove-preference prefer_variant --dry-run=true
# apply
rictl policy update --id prod-cost-priority --remove-preference prefer_variant --dry-run=false
rictl deploy --policy prod-cost-priority --env prod
```

deploy-bot: Deploy started: deploy-8821 (policy update). Canary 10% traffic -> checking quality gate.

deploy-bot: Canary failed — automated quality gate reported throughput/quality drop at 10% canary. Deploy paused automatically. :warning:

raj (runtime): Canary failed because the canary still allowed redwood-7b-lite-4q for certain routes (policy precedence bug). We need a stronger mitigation: block variant at serving runtime to force immediate routing away.

alex (eng-runtime): Executing variant block now.
```
rictl variant block --model redwood-7b-lite-4q --env prod --reason "emergency block due to quality regression"
# response: 200 OK, change propagated
```

incident-bot: Variant block applied. Recomputing routing... observed traffic to redwood-7b-lite-4q drop 58% -> 1% within 45s. Quality metrics recovering: QA_accuracy 0.75 -> 0.89 (now trending toward baseline). Monitoring in watch for next 30m. :white_check_mark:

nina (support): Noted customer impact: reached out to top affected accounts (Acme Inc., BlueSky Labs). Escalation INC-19765 created, CS message templates sent. Will update tickets with mitigation and offer credits if needed.

lee (product): Thanks team. We need a full postmortem and remediation plan: add policy guardrail to prevent cost_prefer from outranking quality checks, require explicit production canary consent, and add automated similarity/QA gates to routing decisions. @alex @raj can you capture timeline + config diff of the policy change?

alex (eng-runtime): Timeline: change authored by config-bot at 2025-11-03T17:27:50Z, merged by ops-automation, deployed at 17:28:12Z (deploy-8792). I'll attach diffs to the incident doc and create a follow-up ticket for guardrails.

oncall-sre: Handoff to night oncall @lee (product) in 10m — I'm going to stay until metrics stable. Watch thresholds: QA drop > 0.05 or error rate > 1.5% = re-escalate P1. Creating watch in PagerDuty.

incident-bot: Status update: MITIGATED — emergency block applied, traffic returned to expected variants, customer notifications started. Next steps: postmortem, policy rollbacks audit, add automated QA gate to canaries. Incident will remain open for postmortem until remediation complete. Closing pager for now. :memo:
